prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1344; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the claimant in connection with the parking lot collision described in the claim you have opened under this file. Our client was injured in the incident and is seeking compensation for medical care, lost income, and the pain and disruption that followed. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of every policy that may apply to the insured driver and vehicle involved, together with a copy of the declarations page for each. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage exists.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, vehicle data, surveillance or parking lot video, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while the claim remains open.
